name: defer-queue
description: Hold a prompt sent mid-turn until Claude finishes the turn, then send it as a turn of its own (no steering).

defer_all_mid_turn.title: Defer every mid-turn prompt
defer_all_mid_turn.description: Off: only prompts sent with chat:queueSubmit (ctrl+x enter) wait for the turn to end. On: every prompt typed while Claude works waits, so nothing steers a running turn.
